continuity_scope: Netflix's 2017 Castlevania animated-series continuity only, bounded to Season 1 Episodes 1–2 ("Witchbottle" and "Necropolis") and contemporary official Netflix launch/episode credits material. Castlevania: Nocturne, all Konami game continuities, comics, later seasons, and all other adaptations are excluded.

coverage_rule: Include the individual dramatic characters named by the selected official episode metadata and launch credits who are material to the opening setup: Dracula, Lisa, The Bishop, and Trevor Belmont. Vampires, beasts/demons, the Belmont clan, hunter role, religious institutions, magic, weapons/artifacts, places, and historical framing are retained as terms or omissions rather than character nodes.
omissions: All figures not named in the selected E1–E2 metadata/launch credits are outside this bounded pass, including figures identified by official launch credits but not needed for the selected opening setup.
Nocturne, Konami games, comics, later seasons, other franchise media, and subsequent character arcs are excluded.
E1's episode metadata provides only a compact claim that a corrupt bishop enrages a legend; it does not establish a complete institution, doctrine, real church, or historical population.

The source contains mass-violence/horror context. This pass does not reproduce graphic material or make claims about sexuality, disability, ethnicity, real-world religious groups, or historical events beyond the narrowly cited fictional premises.
uncertainties: The selected official metadata is synopsis/credit-level evidence, not a full screenplay or scene-by-scene analysis; all character claims remain at that level.

Netflix's official release calls the work a dark medieval fantasy and describes a fictional threat to Eastern Europe. It is not treated as historical testimony about medieval Europe, Transylvania, churches, or any actual person.
The Tudum summary identifies Lisa as Dracula's wife and describes her execution as the spur for his action, but this pass avoids detailed circumstances, moral interpretation, and later consequences.
evidence_basis: Official Netflix title page, Netflix launch release, and Netflix Tudum editorial/series material only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, recap, unofficial transcript, game database, or non-Netflix adaptation source is used.
